input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user token state, user, authority. The platform provides capabilities for user, user, custom user details. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user token state records, so that I can track and organize user token state data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage authority records, so that I can track and organize authority data effectively.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
